item.title: Vehicle completely blocking access road to multiple properties (Parked in Bus Stop), 15th August
item.description:
A black Kia (Registration: LY25 FUD) is illegally parked directly in a marked bus stop, completely blocking the access road off Bellegrove Road, Welling. ​This is the designated road to access a number of properties. Because of this vehicle's position within the bus stop, the entrance to the lane is completely impassable, and all residents are currently blocked from entering or exiting with their vehicles. ​I have already reported this severe obstruction to the authorities and received the following reference numbers: ​Met Police Reference: CAD 6847/15Aug26 ​Bexley Emergency References: ENQ-635885 (Parking) and ENQ-328041 ​I have attached a photograph clearly showing the vehicle's registration, the bus stop markings, and the blocked access road. Immediate enforcement action is required.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 69, Bellegrove Road, Welling, Greater London
